detail.description:
Marketing Manager

We are looking for an experienced Marketing Manager to lead our marketing activities, build brand awareness, and support business growth.

Key responsibilities:

    • Develop and execute the annual marketing strategy.
    • Plan and manage digital campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, and other channels.
    • Monitor key KPIs, including:
    • website traffic,
    • MQLs and SQLs,
    • conversion rates,
    • CPL / CAC,
    • marketing ROI.
    • Work closely with Sales to improve lead generation and pipeline development.
    • Coordinate content creation, webinars, events, and social media activities.
    • Manage external agencies, freelancers, and technology partners.
    • Analyze campaign performance and recommend improvements.

Requirements:

    • 4+ years of experience in marketing.
    • Experience with B2B marketing and lead generation.
    • Strong knowledge of digital marketing tools.
    • Hands-on experience with Google Analytics, CRM, and marketing automation.
    • Excellent communication and project-management skills.
    • English: B2/C1.

Nice to have:

    • SaaS or technology-sector experience;
    • experience with HubSpot or Salesforce;
    • knowledge of SEO/SEM;
    • experience managing a marketing budget of €100k+ per year.

What we offer:

    • Competitive salary + performance bonus.
    • Hybrid work: 2–3 days remotely per week.
    • Private healthcare & training budget.
    • Flexible working hours.
    • Real influence on marketing strategy and company growth.

Location: Warsaw / Hybrid

Employment: Full-time

Start date: ASAP
